input.command:
cd src && sed -i 's/SECONDS_PER_UNIT/MS_PER_UNIT/g; s/{ s: 1, m: 60, h: 3600, d: 86400 }/{ s: 1000, m: 60_000, h: 3_600_000, d: 86_400_000 }/; s/returns its length in seconds/returns its length in milliseconds/' duration.ts
sed -i 's/ \* 1000//' cache.ts retry.ts scheduler.ts
sed -i 's/String(parseDuration(wait))/String(Math.floor(parseDuration(wait) \/ 1000))/' http.ts
sed -i 's/\${parseDuration(settings.timeout)}s/${parseDuration(settings.timeout) \/ 1000}s/; s/\${parseDuration(settings.ttl)}s/${parseDuration(settings.ttl) \/ 1000}s/' report.ts
sed -i 's/MIN_TTL_SECONDS = 5;/MIN_TTL_MS = 5 * 1000;/; s/MAX_TTL_SECONDS = 24/MAX_TTL_MS = 24/; s/60 \* 60;/60 * 60 * 1000;/; s/MIN_TTL_SECONDS/MIN_TTL_MS/; s/MAX_TTL_SECONDS/MAX_TTL_MS/; s/seconds/ms/g' validate.ts
cd ../test && sed -i 's/"30s"), 30)/"30s"), 30_000)/; s/"5m"), 300)/"5m"), 300_000)/; s/"2h"), 7200)/"2h"), 7_200_000)/; s/"1d"), 86400)/"1d"), 86_400_000)/; s/" 10s "), 10)/" 10s "), 10_000)/' duration.test.ts
cd .. && git diff src && grep -rn "1000" src; npm test 2>&1 | tail -20
